about: Character art still to be generated (Higgsfield text-to-image). Each request is one image; tools/import_generated.py cuts it into the named sprites. Figures are matched to outputs left to right. Generate in priority order.
style: Hand-painted 2D game art in a cosy storybook style: fine dark-brown ink outlines, textured gouache and coloured-pencil shading with subtle paper grain and speckles, warm muted autumn palette (rust, ochre, olive, denim blue, cream), soft warm light, semi-realistic proportions, gentle expressive faces. Plain flat pure white background, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no border.

characters.luis: Luis Delgado, a warm Latino corner-store owner in his mid 60s, stocky, grey swept-back hair, thick grey moustache, deep smile lines, blue plaid flannel shirt with the sleeves rolled up under a faded olive-green canvas shop apron, brown work trousers, worn black work shoes, a pencil tucked behind one ear
characters.priya: Priya Raman, a South Asian woman in her early 30s who works night shifts as an ER nurse, long black hair in a loose low braid, small gold nose stud, tired but kind eyes, teal hospital scrubs under an enormous mustard-yellow knit cardigan, ID badge on a lanyard, white sneakers
characters.haddad: Fatima Haddad, a small round-faced Lebanese grandmother in her 70s, plum-purple patterned headscarf, reading glasses on a beaded chain, long dark-green cardigan over a long navy skirt, sensible black shoes
characters.kai: Kai, a cheerful androgynous bike courier in their early 20s, East Asian, short messy black hair with one bleached streak, a bright orange rain jacket worn open over a grey hoodie, black cargo trousers rolled at the ankle, high-top sneakers, a big grey messenger bag worn across the body with a bike helmet clipped to it
characters.june: June Ito, a small Japanese-American retired schoolteacher in her 70s, short curly grey hair, round tortoiseshell glasses, gentle smile, rust-orange knit cardigan over a cream blouse with a small floral print, khaki trousers, brown lace-up boots
characters.remy: Remy Castillo, a young Latina barista and mural painter in her mid 20s, pink hair tied up in a messy bun with loose strands, small hoop earrings, a black denim jacket with the sleeves pushed up over a dark red button-up shirt, dark jeans flecked with paint, black boots
